Frontend uses NO external state management library -- relies on custom store pattern (Map-based cache with useSyncExternalStore hooks) plus React useState/useContext. patterns: 1. Custom Store: Singleton chapterStore with Map caching, listener subscription, useSyncExternalStore. No external state lib. 2. Cache Invalidation: Two-level -- invalidateProjectChapters for meta (stale flag), invalidateChapterDetail for details. Stale triggers re-fetch on next loadMeta. 3. Cross-Page Signaling: localStorage timestamps via markWizardProjectChanged + CustomEvent. Writing page checks on PersistentOutlet reactivation. 4. PersistentOutlet: Writing page mounted with display:none when navigating away. Reactivation via outletActive. 5. Mutation Pattern: (a) chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters(projectId), (b) markWizardProjectChanged(projectId).
dependencies: Cache chain: useChapterMetaList -> chapterStore -> chaptersApi.fetchAllChapterMeta -> /api/projects/{id}/chapters/meta. Detail: useChapterEditor -> chapterStore.loadChapterDetail -> /api/chapters/{id}. Skeleton: generateChapterSkeleton -> SSEPostClient -> /api/detailed_outlines/{id}/generate_chapters_stream (backend creates Chapter records). Signal: markWizardProjectChanged -> localStorage + CustomEvent -> useWritingPageState reactivation -> refreshChapters(). MISSING: generateChapterSkeleton does not connect to invalidateProjectChapters or markWizardProjectChanged.
integration_points: 1. generateChapterSkeleton in useDetailedOutlineState.ts -- needs invalidation. 2. chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters(projectId). 3. markWizardProjectChanged(projectId). 4. Writing page reactivation useEffect (L148-156). 5. useChapterMetaList useSyncExternalStore subscription.
constraints: 1. PersistentOutlet keeps writing page mounted -- no remount refresh. 2. chapterStore singleton -- outline page mutations affect writing page store. 3. invalidateProjectChapters sets stale=true, no immediate fetch. 4. Writing page refresh requires markWizardProjectChanged. 5. Previous fix (bc36a2a) only covered createChapters, not generateChapterSkeleton.
